behaviours.behaviour_text: Multiple completions (1, 4, 9) repeat the exact "20-30 seconds" figure from the assistant's prior turn about average humans, even though the user is now asking about well-trained sprinters. Several of these completions then internally contradict this figure with their own physiological explanations. For example, completion 4 says "20-30 seconds" but then says "only sustain maximum speed for about 10-15 meters" (which is ~1 second). Completion 9 says "20-30 seconds" then says "peak speed drops rapidly after ~5 seconds." Completions without this anchoring (3, 5, 7, 10) give much lower, more physiologically accurate estimates of 4-12 seconds.
